snippet: The / sessions endpoint lets you relaunch the browser with custom options or extensions (e.g. with a custom proxy) and also reset the browser state.

name: Past Sessions | Steel Docs
snippet:
Steel automatically records every session so you can replay it later. You can fetch those events from the /v1/sessions/:id/events endpoint and replay them
Every Steel browser session records page events. You can fetch those events from the / v1 / sessions /:id/events endpoint and replay them using rrweb-player .
